title: WorkcellRequest
description: Request issued by RMF2.0 to a workcell. The request field names the operation; params carries request-specific arguments and is intentionally open to accommodate any workcell type.

requestId.description: Unique ID for tracking this request against a state response

request.description: Request to perform, e.g. pick, place, start_mixing, inspect

params.description: Request-specific params — open schema, validated against Custom Workcell Type
